entries.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one production game spritesheet asset for PawTrail. The attached image is the PARENT BOSS visual reference only: create related subordinate monsters, not copies or crops of the boss. Match its deliberately coarse 16-bit pixel art, jagged crisp dark outlines, detailed small color clusters, upper-left light, restrained cel shading. Strict fixed three-quarter top-down RPG view, facing toward the viewer with a slight left angle. Transparent background, NO scene, labels, grid lines, borders, text, gradients or ground shadows. EXACTLY 5 COLUMNS by 5 ROWS, equally sized square cells in a square canvas. Each ROW is one consistent identity; five poses in order LEFT TO RIGHT: (1) alert idle, (2) a clearly different forward walking step or hovering drift, (3) strong attack ANTICIPATION with head/limbs/weapon drawn back, (4) strong ACTIVE attack pose with head/limbs/weapon extended, (5) visibly HURT recoiling pose. All five poses retain the exact same anatomy, markings and equipment, same scale and grounded baseline, centered inside their own cell. Leave 10 percent transparent padding within each cell, never overlap cells. All anatomy, tails, wings and blades fully inside cell boundaries. No detached VFX, no projectile in another cell. Each row's frames must change pose visibly, not just expression. Rows 1 and 2 are the same mini-boss in normal/enraged forms; rows 3 to 5 are three DISTINCT smaller related monster designs. Render all rows with similar pixel detail; the game will apply world size. A polished but genuinely pixelated browser RPG asset, not smooth illustration or 3D render. ROW 1: Gloamwarden, a stocky free-roaming TWO-HEADED violet rift drake, obsidian stone armor, lavender throats, brass shrine bands, four clawed feet and a short spiked tail. No wall/base attached. ROW 2: the SAME Gloamwarden enraged, cracked stone armor, bright magenta inner fissures, raised crystalline spines. ROW 3: Riftling, one small violet horned dragon hatchling with broad ears and a short tail. ROW 4: Shardback, a low four-legged purple crystal-armored reptile with a broad rocky back and narrow glowing eyes. ROW 5: Ashwing, a small dark-purple bat-winged drake with two feet, small horns and a clearly visible lilac belly.
entries.processing: hard alpha, nearest-neighbor registered poses and limited-palette lossless exports
